item.title: Implement SAML as an external provider in an ASP.NET Core Identity application using Duende as an OIDC server
item.description: This article shows how to implement a SAML federation from an ASP.NET Core Identity application using Sustainsys.Saml2.AspNetCore2. Entra ID is used to implement the SAML authentication and the users can authenticate from the tenant.
